_comment: Failure Reconstructed growth & quality settings. Missing keys fall back to lib/ayar.js defaults. No secrets here — secrets live in .env.

disclosure.label: AI RECONSTRUCTION
disclosure.voiceNote: Narration uses a synthetic voice. Footage is real archival film or licensed stock; anything reconstructed is labelled on screen.

schedule._comment: Fallback only: channels set publishTime 18:00 in publishTimeZone America/New_York (US evening; audience ~93% US, analytics 2026-09-25), which core/scheduling/calendar.js converts with DST. hourUTC approximates it for legacy helpers. Only PUBLISH is uploadable and scheduled; REVIEW/BLOCK never leave the runner.

renk._comment: Channel colour grade for modern stock footage ('strong documentary', chosen 2026-09-25): colour halved, cooler steel shadows, slightly lifted blacks and softened highlights, so stock sits with the archival films while staying clearly colour (never faked as B&W archive). Archival film is untouched. Empty string disables it.
